name: minsky-core
description: Minsky org process law, org-authored only. Skills: wrap, ship-issue, verify-package, watch-it-work, harden-slice, db-change, add-vertical. Hooks: wrap-nag (Stop reminder when code changed since last wrap), comment-length (max consecutive comment lines, threshold from repo .claude/comment-policy, default 1). Third-party skills live in minsky-vendored.
